prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you put ketchup on a hot dog in the city of Chicago. Respond to the committee.
response:
*adjusts tie, leans into microphone*

Mr. Chairman, distinguished members of the Committee, I appear before you today of my own volition, with nothing to hide.

I want to state, clearly and for the record: I have never put ketchup on a hot dog within the city limits of Chicago. I am not now, nor have I ever been, a ketchup-on-a-hot-dog person.

I am aware of the photograph the Committee has entered into evidence. I would note, first, that the image is blurry. Second, the red substance in question could easily be a sport pepper that has been tragically crushed. Third — and I say this under oath — the alleged incident occurred in *Skokie*, which I am advised falls outside this Committee's cookout jurisdiction.

Do I know individuals who have applied ketchup to a hot dog? Mr. Chairman, I was in college. It was a different time. There were experimental toppings everywhere. I attended one — *one* — gathering where ketchup was present on the condiment table, and I left as soon as I understood the nature of what was happening there.

I wish to further affirm my loyalty to the correct order: yellow mustard, chopped white onion, sweet neon-green relish, a dill pickle spear, tomato wedges, sport peppers, and a dash of celery salt, all upon a poppy seed bun. I have dragged dogs through the garden with pride, sir. With *pride*.

I will name no names. I will not tell this Committee who I may or may not have seen reaching for the Heinz at a Bears tailgate in 2019. A man's condiments are between him and his conscience — unless he's in Chicago, in which case they are between him and this Committee, apparently.

I would remind the Committee that ketchup on a hot dog is not illegal. Disappointing? Deeply. Un-Chicagoan? Certainly. But this body's mandate must not become a witch hunt against those who merely *stood near* a ketchup packet.

I yield the remainder of my time, and respectfully request access to the water pitcher, as I have been sweating like a Vienna Beef on a flat-top since these proceedings began.
